title: START_HERE
universal_lens: The sovereign primitive unifies raw resource ingestion and rights-gated deployment via a hierarchical state-transition operator. It models the pipeline as a conservative projection from an expansive ambient tool-space into a strictly constrained, verified subspace, ensuring zero-leakage of unauthorized or piracy-adjacent elements through terminal quarantine states.
gsi_mapping: In GSI, this acts as a conformal risk filter for data provenance. The classifier assigns high posterior probability to 'quarantine' when contextual priors indicate piracy-adjacency. Free-first sourcing serves as a cost-aware Bayesian update, maximizing statistical utility while minimizing financial expenditure on paid API endpoints.
gse_mapping: For GSE, the engine dictates situational state transitions: raw intake is never directly actionable. Only assets passing the `findGatedLeaks` invariant and free-source verification transition to the 'approved-direct' state. This ensures the tactical execution layer operates exclusively on leak-free, legally cleared primitives.

primitives.name: Terminal Quarantine Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Quarantine is terminal.** Piracy / evasion / circumvention (torrents, IPTV, ROMs, cracks/keygens, CAPTCHA/paywall/login/DRM bypass, jailbreak/leaked prompts, proxy rotation to circumvent, fake accounts).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Q: Terminal quarantine state (dimensionless boolean); x: Input resource vector; P(x): Piracy adjacency indicator function.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a binary safety boundary where any intersection with evasion vectors necessitates absolute exclusion from the active registry.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the piracy adjacency detection function P(x) yields false negatives, allowing circumvention tools to bypass the terminal gate.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a hard constraint satisfaction problem in GSE, where violating the quarantine predicate immediately collapses the valid action space to zero.
layer2.telemetry: Count of resources permanently locked in the quarantine ledger without promotion.

primitives.name: Free-First Cost Policy Router
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Free-first sourcing (added) Doctrine: use every FREE, cleared source before any paid API — without losing stats quality.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C_f: Cost of free source (0 currency units); C_p: Cost of paid API (>0 currency units); U: Statistical utility metric.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the existence of a sufficient set of free adapters that can maintain acceptable statistical utility U without invoking paid endpoints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if free sources experience prolonged downtime or schema drift, forcing a fallback to paid APIs despite the cost policy.

layer2.mapping: Derives a cost-minimization kernel for GSI inference, prioritizing HTTP 200 verified free adapters over expensive proprietary feeds.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of successful data fetches from free-adapters versus paid API calls per season.

reasoning_traces.think:
The mathematical foundation of the Galaxy 2026 Limit Push rests on constructing a rigorous filtration operator acting upon a massive, unstructured input manifold—the Garrett resource dump. We define the ambient space \mathcal{A} as the set of all ~11k raw tool names. The core objective is to project \mathcal{A} onto a strictly bounded, operationally viable subspace \mathcal{V} \subset \mathcal{A}, representing the 'approved-direct' and 'prototype' states. This projection is governed by a composite operator \Phi = \Psi_{cost} \circ \Omega_{quarantine}. First, \Omega_{quarantine} acts as a hard topological cut. By defining a piracy-adjacency metric d_P(x, \mathcal{P}), where \mathcal{P} is the set of known evasion vectors, any resource x satisfying d_P < \delta is mapped to a terminal sink state Q. This ensures the integrity of the remaining space. Second, \Psi_{cost} implements the free-first doctrine. For any remaining resource x, we evaluate its cost functional C(x). The router enforces a strict ordering: if \exists x_{free} such that Utility(x_{free}) \approx Utility(x_{paid}) and C(x_{free}) = 0, then x_{paid} is suppressed. The dualities emerge between the expansive nature of raw research intake and the extreme contraction required for production deployment. Failure modes are primarily characterized by leakage—where \Omega fails to identify novel evasion proxies—or starvation, where \Psi overly restricts access to necessary paid data during free-source outages. The entire system relies on the conservative assumption that over-blocking is the only stable equilibrium for maintaining legal and operational sovereignty.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architecture inherits from early information retrieval filtering systems but adapts them for modern, high-stakes quantitative environments. Historically, spam filters pioneered the 'conservative classification' regime, accepting high false-positive rates to ensure zero false negatives in critical inboxes. Similarly, the 'free-first' doctrine echoes the open-source software movement's preference for community-maintained, zero-cost dependencies over proprietary lock-ins. The terminal quarantine concept derives from cybersecurity sandboxing, where unverified executables are permanently isolated rather than dynamically analyzed, reflecting a shift from reactive to preemptive mathematical governance in data pipelines.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the opposing agent not as a malicious hacker, but as an opportunistic entropy maximizer seeking to inject low-quality, legally precarious, or costly dependencies into the sovereign engine. The decision actor (the pipeline architect) anticipates this by assuming any unverified resource carries a latent payload of technical debt or legal exposure. The theory of mind here is adversarial compliance: the system assumes that external APIs will inevitably degrade, change schemas, or introduce hidden costs. Therefore, the router acts with extreme skepticism, treating every new endpoint as a potential threat until it passes rigorous fixture testing and live HTTP 200 verification. This paranoid stance protects the core statistical models from poisoning via corrupted or biased third-party feeds.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced by strictly decoupling the raw intake layer from the execution layer. A critical veto condition is triggered if any resource in the 'approved-direct' set shares a structural signature with the 'quarantine' set, indicating a failure in the conservative classifier. Furthermore, leakage vetoes occur if the free-first router attempts to invoke a paid API before exhausting all verified free adapters, violating the cost-policy invariant. The system mandates that no asset can transit from the raw dump to the StatKing evidence registry without passing through both the quarantine filter and the free-source exhaustion check. This cross-layer isolation ensures that a compromise or outage in the external data provider layer cannot cascade into the core probabilistic inference engines of GSI/GSE.
